name: overclock
description: Overclock — Claude Code plugins that run your model past spec.

plugins.name: overclock-setup
plugins.description: Choose and configure Overclock plugins without guesswork. A manual, report-only setup advisor that inventories current plugin and instruction state, asks only decision-changing questions, blocks incompatible combinations, and returns exact proposed commands and minimal CLAUDE.md diffs without executing or writing anything.

plugins.name: session-memory
plugins.description: Stop losing your working state. Warm session resume (handoffs with git-anchored drift detection) plus lessons that persist across sessions — corrections stop evaporating, failed approaches stop being retried.

plugins.name: learning-loop
plugins.description: A self-improvement loop for your agent. Corrections ("no, use pnpm, not npm") and diagnosed failures become durable, evidence-counted lessons in .ai/memory/LESSONS.md, deduplicated by meaning and surfaced in later sessions so the same mistakes stop recurring. Standalone lessons-only alternative to session-memory; do not install both because both route the same lesson workflow and ship a lesson SessionStart hook.

plugins.name: natural-writing
plugins.description: Make AI drafts read like a human wrote them. A prose writing/editing skill for blog posts, articles, and essays that strips the tells which mark text as AI-generated (em-dashes, words like 'delve'/'leverage', uniform sentence rhythm, bot scaffolding) so you can use AI without rewriting everything by hand. Preserves quotes verbatim and stays silent on code, commit messages, and one-line edits.

plugins.name: critical-thinking
plugins.description: Get clear-eyed analysis instead of agreeable answers. Tests user framing, separates evidence from assumptions, calibrates uncertainty, and delegates material local-evidence questions to a fresh bounded research context without generic praise or reflexive contrarianism.

plugins.name: pr-feedback
plugins.description: Work through reviewer feedback on a GitHub PR instead of relitigating it by hand. Fetches every unresolved review thread and comment in one paginated pass, judges each item centrally against the actual code, applies valid fixes to the working tree, and drafts quoted replies — posting and resolving only after explicit approval. Never commits, pushes, merges, or approves.

plugins.name: discipline-gates
plugins.description: Pre-action engineering gates backed by real evidence: reproduce bugs before fixing, characterize untested behavior before refactoring, prove new tests can fail with safe mutation restore, and recover defensive-code intent from git history before weakening it.
